registered: 2026-10-17, after WP1 and before any WP2 candidate was evaluated

per_cell_change.phase: x_c = E_c(k-1) - E_c(k-2) + r_c(k-1)*(d(k-1) - d(k-2)); E_c = the cell's location at SUB's E programs; r_c = Theil-Sen of the cell over SUB's rate-fit programs (days from the first of them), 0 when SUB's r is 0
per_cell_change.then: Q = SUB's anchor term + beta_used * combine(x_c) (phase) or + combine(inc_c) (fallback)

candidates.B1: combine = median over cells (mean of the middle two); per-cell locations of the ctx's detection variant
candidates.B2: combine = one-cell rejection: dev_c = x_c - median of the other three; if max |dev_c| > tau_v drop that cell and average the other three, else average all four; tau_v = 3*sqrt(2)*sigma_det,v (WP0)
candidates.B3: B2 on WP1's adopted A3 locations (median over the 6 variants per cell), tau = 3*sqrt(2)*sigma_det of the A3 ensemble (WP1 diagnostics)

B3_robustness: leave-one-variant-out A3 ensembles (5 variants, median, >= 4 finite) vs SUB on main, tau fixed at B3_tau_Ah
branch_freeze: SUB selection on the ctx's detection variant (B1, B2) or on main (B3) replayed (D0.1)
gates: EXECUTION_PROMPT.md section 4; G_robust for B1/B2: candidate on variant v vs SUB on variant v; for B3: LOVO as above
G_event_for_change_candidates: change-based candidates have no position series; G_event uses the chained series (D2.1): within each segment start at the 4-cell mean of the first program and add combine(per-cell change between consecutive programs); compared with SUB's mean-of-main series
adoption: passing = all gates; lowest causal mean (main); ties within 0.002 pp -> simplicity_order
diagnostics: rejection log (B2, B3): per case dropped cell, |dev|, month; share of rejections per cell vs round 8 pattern (cell1, cell3)
per-checkup real errors and SOH at delta 0.4
